newsitem.title: USA: One Up president, CEO resigns.
newsitem.headline: One Up president, CEO resigns.

text.p: One Up Corp said on Friday Richard Dews, its president, chairman and chief executive officer, had resigned.
Dews' duties would be assumed in the interim by Wayne Sanderson, vice president and controller, it said.
He was now the sole director of the company and was exploring alternatives to reconstitute the board of directors and senior management, including talks with significant shareholders of the company.
One Up provides software management and migration services to businesses and software developers.
